purpose: Read-only registry of possible execution routes. The radar may paper-test standard, conditional, and route_unknown ideas, but live execution must only use confirmed standard routes after separate live-trading gates are enabled.

route_states.standard: All hard paper-route requirements are confirmed or not applicable.
route_states.conditional: The idea is paper-testable, but live execution needs confirmed broker, borrow, permission, fee, margin, jurisdiction, or API capability.
route_states.route_unknown: The asset may be tradable, but no practical route family is documented yet.
route_states.blocked: The route is not paper-testable or should not be used.

routes.broker: OKX public derivatives data / paper route
routes.notes: Paper route for OKX perpetual-only or perp-plus-long-spot hedge ideas. Live execution still requires credentials, jurisdiction checks, limits, and explicit live enablement.
jurisdiction_notes: Verify venue availability and legal access before any live route.

requirements.description: Account/config allows crypto derivatives paper routing.
requirements.how_to_verify: Confirm account_capabilities.crypto_derivatives is true and the venue supports the instrument.

requirements.description: OKX public market data is reachable.
requirements.how_to_verify: Run the OKX scanner and confirm recent ticker/funding data is returned.

requirements.description: Live OKX derivatives eligibility has not been checked.
requirements.how_to_verify: Confirm jurisdiction, account eligibility, and venue terms before live trading.
